value.author: sceneGroup
value.layerInfo: Simulate a light source moving across a Layer.

direction: Set the angle the sweep moves across a Layer in degrees.
shape: Select a shape for the sweep.
centre: Set the light sweep's centre point.
coneWidth: Set the width of the light beam.
conePercentage: Set the distance the light beam's opacity begins to falloff as a percentage from its centre to its edge.
useFalloff: When the Shape is set to Line, limit the light sweep's distance from the Centre along its Y axis.
falloffDistance: Set the distance over which the light falls off after passing the Centre.
edgeIntensity: Set the intensity of an additional glow at the edges of the light sweep.
edgeThickness: Set the thickness of the light sweep's edges.
lightColor: Set the color of the light.
